output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Everyone on build 7.4.0 crashes at about 2%, including before the flag ramp began, while 7.3.2 stays near 0.7%. Within 7.4.0, flagged users (2.10%) and the random flag-off holdout (1.98%) are close. The difference is within noise, so a small flag effect, a few tenths of a point, can't be ruled out. Device mix and usage are the same across groups, and the app store's own crash counts match the crash-reporting tool's. The leading crash cluster is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda, HEIF decoding), at 41% of events. It first appeared on 2 Sep and doesn't occur in 7.3.2. Canvas code doesn't appear in any cluster. Flag users only look worse because only 7.4.0 users can get the flag. Don't turn the flag off and release 7.4.0 to 100% on the 18th. That would spread the real crashes to everyone. Hold the rollout at 25% and fix the image-library crashes. Keep the flag holdout running (or widen it) to settle the small flag effect, and don't close the incident. I'm fairly confident, though not certain which exact code path in the image library triggers the crashes.
